description: A polyglot document intelligence framework with a Rust core. Extract text, metadata, images, and structured data from 101 formats (115 file extensions) plus code intelligence for 371 code languages. 15 language bindings — Rust, Python, Ruby, Java, Go, PHP, Elixir, C#, TypeScript — plus CLI, REST API, and MCP server.
